LESSON: LISTENING FOR INFORMATION, ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.6: Listening for information, Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for information, Oral Expression, part of Listening and speaking in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use polite language? 13 bitte...; Darf ich.... bestellen/haben?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mention various foods one can order from their local restaurant,

2. talk to peers about favourite meals in restaurants,

3. listen to/watch audio/video about situations in restaurants (bestellen,bezahlen) and answer questions,

4. discuss with peers about foods and language used,

5. listen to/watch audio-visual texts and pay attention to the language structures (z.B. Ich möchte bitte...; Darf ich.... bestellen/haben?; Danke; Bitte schön, usw),

6. ask and respond to questions from peers using the language structures above (z.B. Ich möchte

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mention various foods one can order from their local restaurant,
2. talk to peers about favourite meals in restaurants,
3. listen to/watch audio/video about situations in restaurants (bestellen,bezahlen) and answer questions,
4. discuss with peers about foods and language used,
5. listen to/watch audio-visual texts and pay attention to the language structures (z.B. Ich möchte bitte...; Darf ich.... bestellen/haben?; Danke; Bitte schön, usw),
6. ask and respond to questions from peers using the language structures above (z.B. Ich möchte

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for information, Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner develops the skill of knowing and voicing his/her needs when s/he asks and responds to questions in

a restaurant situation.

Values:
Unity: the learner demonstrates awareness of the value of inclusion when s/he interacts with peers about favourite meals in

restaurants.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health Education – healthy eating habits: the learner develops an awareness of healthy eating habits when s/he listens to

people talking about their favourite meals and eating habits in restaurants.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner links the knowledge of food acquired in this sub-strand to the same content learnt in Agriculture.
